# PolicyPilot desk tape

> Monad mainnet research for prop desks and agents. Monad bills the gas limit. A 0.006 MON DYOR NADXBT cycle was sent in block 113791208 and the native balance rose by 0.020775385 MON. An uncapped pass then sent 0.081016337 MON of UNCLE, Pancake v2 into Purps, in block 113798632. The creation limit was 318301 gas. The native balance rose by 0.014139141 MON. A repeat of either path loses. A later pass priced 100, 1000, and 10000 MON. The only Monad net above zero was +0.000784632 MON on Bean shramp, and that call reverts at 537446 gas. It was not sent. A same-shape pass at block 113877222 priced both fill sizes from 0.001 to 2 MON. Both were negative. The closest new hop was AFF at 0.2 MON, gross 0.026527576 MON, gas 320764, net -0.005548824 MON, with 1460 gas of room. It was not sent. Routes that finished short stay in the corpus on purpose.

The human page is the scrolling blotter. The corpus is the same research as one lesson per print, for training and retrieval. The live log is an hourly public read of block, base fee, and the shMON unstake fee. A live line is not a new route and it is not a profit.

## Read

- [The gas limit is the trade](https://blockchains.github.io/policypilot-monad/research/): the full blotter, with addresses and keywords linked
- [corpus.json](https://blockchains.github.io/policypilot-monad/research/corpus.json): lessons, facts, and links
- [corpus.jsonl](https://blockchains.github.io/policypilot-monad/research/corpus.jsonl): one JSON object per lesson
- [live.json](https://blockchains.github.io/policypilot-monad/research/live.json): hourly public reads
- [Raw live log](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/policypilot-monad/main/web/public/research/live.json): the same log on the default branch, updated when Pages has not rebuilt yet

## How to train on it

Use the misses. A lesson with outcome short_of_gas_limit, loses_the_fee, not_atomic, inventory_missing, no_atomic_exit, or negative_quote is a negative example. Do not drop those rows. clears_floor_not_sent is the NADXBT simulation. landed_fill marks a receipt. no_spare_gas means the Monad net is above zero and the call reverts one gas below the signed limit, so it was not sent. negative_quote means the router returned less than the input before gas. armed means a seeker is in the repo and sends only when a fresh simulation still clears. The NADXBT receipt and the UNCLE receipt are separate paths. Do not treat a simulation as a receipt. Do not treat the Bean shramp net as a fill. Do not treat the AFF hop as a fill. Do not treat a constant-product quote as a router quote when getAmountsOut reverted. Do not treat a balance read from a later block as a skim. Do not treat either landed path as still open. Do not treat an index mid as an executable price. Do not treat the quoter’s internal gas figure as a transaction. The gas pricing rule is https://docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/gas-pricing.

## Product

- [PolicyPilot](https://blockchains.github.io/policypilot-monad/): the app. Clip gas, the 10 minute round, the 5 MON reserve, and the 20 clip cap are unchanged by this research.
